note: Private test IPA 756, for the maintainer's requests of 15-16 November 2026 (after the IPA 745 logs: instability first, then FPS regularity; « Le Mode asynchrone pour tous les jeux le nécessitant » ; the phone must stay cool, in menus and in play, and an IPA only once thermal fixes are applied; a minimal FPS / CPU / RAM / NeoSwap performance bar): the verified IPA 754 (run 43787137375, IPA 6b2c7b3e) with RPCS3 Core 939 request 2 in place of Core 938 and the new performance bar. Core 939: asynchronous shader compilation by default (the global value migrates once; database and per-game values still apply), the 256 MiB pipeline cache limit, the glslang prewarm, the guest memory of the Black Ops II job-queue freeze at 3 s (RPCS3-freeze-guest-<n>.bin, measurement only), and the heat part: idle SPU pollers wait longer and, in a light game only, sleep on the efficiency cores under a self-check; the God of War III pre-validation worker leaves the PPU class; WFE and other-thread probes. Request 2 carries the fixes of the adversarial review of request 1 (no yield for a skipped draw on iOS, the shader worker stops between builds at teardown, the capture limited to Black Ops II with a free-space check and fault-free copies). The S2Arm engine of patches 0001-0047 (verified pin e1ffb7e5) replaces the 754 one, as § 3.12 of the recipe requires for an engine pin changed after the base: the S2Arm session's work, also drafted as its IPA 755 (754 with this engine and Core 938). The NeoPlay Cast receiver stage 2 stays source only for IPA 757. Nothing has run on an iPhone; no heat, energy or FPS claim.
